blocks.text: The most beautiful day in the universe will take place in Puerto Rico as the 2026 Miss Universe pageant culminates at the coronation night on Nov. 24 (25 in Manila). Viewers from the Philippines can catch the show at 9 a.m. online on the iWant streaming platform, and on Kapamilya Channel and Metro Channel on cable and digital, and AllTV2 and A2Z on free TV, and will be beamed to more than 100 countries around the world. The Miss Universe 2026 pageant will be held at the José Miguel Agrelot Coliseum in San Juan, Puerto Rico where reigning queen Fatima Bosch […]...
